description: This Java class implements a multi-factor authentication provider for backup codes, allowing generation and verification of backup codes for users.

classes.name: BackupCodeTwoFaProvider
classes.description: Implements a backup code-based MFA provider, capable of generating backup codes and verifying them for user authentication.

methods.name: generateNewAccountConfig
methods.description: Generates a new backup code account configuration with a specified number of codes.

methods.name: generateCodes
methods.description: Static method that generates a set of unique random codes of specified length.

methods.name: checkVerificationCode
methods.description: Checks if a provided code matches one of the user's backup codes and updates the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of MFA provider, which is BACKUP_CODE.
